comparison.objective: Tighten and fit an already-threaded necktie on a collar form.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated pulling and shaping of a reduced deformable knot and blades.
comparison.success_condition: Released knot meets size, position, blade-order, twist, and tip-height limits for five seconds.
comparison.reason: Deformable garment adjustment is mechanically different from rigid coaxial tooling, locknut restraint, and gripper stop verification.
